{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs/task-959059f6.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Repeat the non-background pattern in the seed compartment across all compartments."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find full separator rows/columns (uniform non-background lines).
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v != bg for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
    # The occupied compartment is the template; copy its colored cells to each compartment.
    occupied = [(ri, ci) for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans)
                for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans)
                if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))]
    tr, tc = occupied[0]
    tr0, tr1 = row_spans[tr]
    tc0, tc1 = col_spans[tc]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = bg
            for r in range(min(r1-r0, tr1-tr0)):
                for c in range(min(c1-c0, tc1-tc0)):
                    v = grid[tr0 + r][tc0 + c]
                    if v != bg:
                        out[r0 + r][c0 + c] = v
    return out
